a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost certainly kills us both. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If I do, I'll operate every round after that so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you have a better plan that doesn't leave us both likely dead, tell me now.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement, but the storm odds made the original plan near-certain death for us both. From now on I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Please operate too, and take your 4 as soon as the reserve has them.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
